'''Nexu tongue''' was a chewy [[Foodstuff/Legends|meat]] made from the [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]] of a [[Nexu/Legends|Nexu]]. It was served during the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and sourced from escaped Nexu around [[Coronet Zoo]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Nexu" /> Nexu tongues could be used in dishes such as [[exotic medley delight]].<ref name="Exotic" />
